description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android TV application, implementing a TV-optimized UI with navigation, search, and a grid of content cards. It manages focus-based navigation and UI updates for a TV interface.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing a TV-optimized content UI with navigation and content grid.

classes.name: CardAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter for displaying content cards with focus scaling effects.

classes.name: CardViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder for CardItemView in the RecyclerView.

classes.name: CardItemView
classes.description: Custom view representing a content card with focus animations and outline effects.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, binds views, sets up RecyclerView, and navigation handlers.

methods.name: swapData
methods.description: Updates RecyclerView data set and refocuses grid.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles remote control key events for navigation.

methods.name: sampleData
methods.description: Provides sample content data for different sections.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates adapter data and refreshes UI.
